issues: Remove unsupported keywords "fanfare" and "advanced"; the source text has neither keyword.

The start-of-end ability is encoded with the opposite condition. It should trigger if there are no other Cool followers on your field, not if there are at least 2 Cool followers. Encode it as an if-condition for 'no other Cool followers' dealing 1 damage to self; this specific 'no other matching followers on your field' condition is not available in the current ability reference and should be implemented.

The activated ability is missing Lesson (1). It should require both [cost03] and Lesson (1) as activation requirements; a Lesson/N-cost condition or cost mechanic is not available in the current ability reference and should be implemented.

The activated ability targets are wrong. It should give each follower on your field +1 attack, not each Cool follower on your field. Encode a field-wide ally follower buff rather than filtering by trait; a generic 'buff all allied followers' operation is not available in the current ability reference and should be implemented.

The start-of-end effect should resolve all applicable clauses in sequence, not let the player choose any subset. Replace the chooseMultiple wrapper with a sequence of conditional effects: if PP >= 2 deal 2 damage to the enemy leader, then if PP >= 4 draw 1, then if PP >= 6 destroy up to 1 enemy follower.

After recovering 2 play points, the remaining start-of-end effect should resolve all applicable clauses in sequence, not let the player choose any subset. Replace the chooseMultiple wrapper with sequential conditional checks for PP >= 2, PP >= 4, and PP >= 6.
The On Evolve search filter is incomplete. It should only allow a Draconic Duelist follower from among the top 4 cards, so add "cardType": "follower" to the searchDeckChoose filter.

The fanfare incorrectly returns all allied field cards by using count 99. It should return any number of cards on your field chosen by you. Encode an optional variable-count self-field return effect; a target selector/effect for 'select any number of allied field cards' is not available in the current ability reference and should be implemented.
